newsitem.title: UK: Shell Rotterdam cuts refinery runs by 14 percent.
newsitem.headline: Shell Rotterdam cuts refinery runs by 14 percent.

text.p: Shell has cut crude throughput at its 350,000 barrel per day Pernis refinery in Rotterdam by "roughly 14 percent" due to poor operating margins, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The cutback was instituted on Monday, said a source familiar with the refinery's operations.
Shell's move followed similar cuts at Texaco and BP's Nerefco complex last week.
Refiners in Europe have had their profit margins decimated by the recent sharp rise in crude price, which has not been matched by an equally strong rise in the value of oil products.

According to Reuters calculations using standard yields, a complex European refinery is now making just over a $1 profit for every barrel of crude processed. A simple refinery in Europe is losing 30 cents on each barrel.
"The run cuts are for economical reasons -- clearly it's all down to poor margins," the source said.
